## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting owner/contributor behavior.

Credit any adopted diagnosis or suggestion with its author's handle and issue/comment
link; include the same credit in the commit body and release notes.

## Breaking changes

Link the relevant short migration notes. State any source, API, USB layout or
installed-state changes; distinguish them from unchanged device paths.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Identify hardware observations separately
from host fixtures, browser simulations and firmware replay. Record unsupported
models and unfinished installation/update/recovery work explicitly.
